title: Relative markdown links are made absolute in content_html
note: Revisions two to seven of 0.4 are not snapshotted; the label bake (data-blyg-label, #81), links[] (#79), CommonMark blockquote extent (#76) and LF/CRLF line endings (#76) come from them, so those cases cite the living text.
ambiguous: §5.2 requires every URL in content_html to be absolute but does not say what a relative URL the author wrote resolves against (the origin, the item's page, the mount). Only absoluteness is checked.
